guitar.notes: Correctly left unknown — not a guitar-led act.

tone.target: clean-funk R&B guitar with wah accents and slight edge-of-breakup
tone.profile: clean-funk R&B guitar with wah accents and slight edge-of-breakup
tone.summary: A classic R&B/Funk chain utilizing a Comp for tight strumming, followed by Wah and a clean Fender-style amp (US Deluxe) paired with a dry cab and spring reverb for that soulful, punchy sound.
corrections: keep wah as the key texture

rig.name: Wilson Pickett - Mustang Sally - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and maintain tight rhythm playing.
Achieve tight, punchy muted strums and consistent dynamics required for funk rhythm.
Provide the essential rhythmic wah accent and vocal texture.
Add slight edge-of-breakup and grit without losing the clean funk character.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used here to simulate a light, natural tube breakup common in R&B/Funk, as dedicated low-gain pedals are limited.

alternatives.reason: Could also work for light grit, but Green OD often provides a more immediate 'pop' suitable for funk.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the clean, bright, punchy sound of a Fender-style amp.
Provide a focused, punchy sound suitable for rhythm guitar in the funk genre.
Tuck the low-mids slightly to prevent muddiness while boosting punch in the critical frequency range.
Add a subtle, vintage spring reverb tail for depth without sounding lush or distracting.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism for better funk punch and definition.

proposals.reason: Enhance the tight, bright punch needed for funk rhythm.
